one_line: Hoysala general and patron of the Keshava temple at Somanathapura, c. 1268 CE.

appearance.face: oval face, medium-brown Deccan complexion, sharp nose, neatly trimmed short beard and moustache, strong brows with a calm, strategic gaze; default expression is composed and resolute with a hint of quiet pride
appearance.hair: thick black hair pulled back into a tight high knot at the crown, sides clean and orderly; forehead adorned with a small white Vaishnava vertical tilaka; wears a simple gold circlet band resting above the knot, with a short cloth tail from the knot falling to mid-neck
appearance.costume: knee-length fitted tunic resembling a quilted padded coat in deep indigo cotton, front opening tied with narrow fabric cords, worn over a long-sleeved off-white under-tunic whose cuffs show at the wrists; lower garment is a sandstone-brown cotton dhoti wrapped warrior-style, pleats in front and hem reaching just above the ankles, bordered with a thin dark green stripe; around his waist a broad russet leather war-belt with small metal studs and two hanging strap ends; over his shoulders, a muted marigold-yellow cotton angavastra draped from left shoulder across the chest and back, secured neatly so it does not hinder movement; forearms protected by simple bronze bracers over the sleeves; feet in dark brown leather sandals with thong straps and a single ankle strap; minimal jewellery—small round gold stud earrings and a narrow gold chain with a modest leaf-shaped pendant resting against the tunic
appearance.signature: a Hoysala-style long sword with a gently curved single-edged steel blade, a plain iron cross-guard, and a dark wooden hilt capped with a small dome-shaped pommel, carried sheathed in a brown leather scabbard slung diagonally across his back and gripped in his right hand when drawn

ref_desc: Soma Dandanayaka is a mid-30s Hoysala general with an oval medium-brown face, high-knot black hair and gold circlet, indigo padded tunic, sandstone-brown dhoti, marigold angavastra, bronze bracers, and a diagonally slung curved long sword in brown leather.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character of Soma Dandanayaka, a mid-30s Hoysala general from 13th-century Somanathapura, standing in a neutral pose. He has an oval medium-brown face, sharp nose, strong brows, and a neatly trimmed short beard and moustache, with a composed, resolute expression. His thick black hair is pulled into a tight high knot at the crown, with a small white Vaishnava tilaka on his forehead and a simple gold circlet band above the knot; a short cloth tail from the knot falls to mid-neck. He wears a knee-length deep indigo fitted tunic like a quilted padded coat, front tied with narrow cords, over a long-sleeved off-white under-tunic showing at the cuffs. His sandstone-brown cotton dhoti is wrapped warrior-style, pleated in front and reaching just above the ankles, edged with a thin dark green border. A broad russet leather war-belt with metal studs circles his waist, with two strap ends hanging. A muted marigold-yellow cotton angavastra is draped from his left shoulder across chest and back, arranged neatly for movement. His forearms bear simple bronze bracers over the sleeves, and his feet are in dark brown leather sandals with thong and ankle straps. He wears small round gold stud earrings and a narrow gold chain with a modest leaf-shaped pendant. His signature weapon is a Hoysala-style long sword with a gently curved single-edged steel blade, plain iron cross-guard, and dark wooden hilt with a dome pommel, sheathed in a brown leather scabbard slung diagonally across his back, with the grip visible over his shoulder. Use deep indigo, sandstone brown, marigold yellow, off-white, and dark brown as the dominant colours.
